lines.quote: Trump winning means no war.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lines.why: Forecasts that a Trump term brings no war, which is the realized side of the war reading.

lines.quote: War is simply not in the cards.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lit: War is simply not in the cards
lines.why: Says war will not come, the no-war side, with no date named so it runs to the end of the term.

lines.quote: Anyone talking about war with Iran is just out to lunch.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lines.why: Dismisses war talk as baseless, which implies no war is coming, though it is aimed at the talkers.

lines.quote: Israel going to war with Iran without us is somehow proving me wrong?
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: Israel going to war with Iran
lines.why: Says the US is not in the war, only Israel, which is a no-US-war state and leans realized.

lines.quote: Are you stupid? (yes)
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: An insult aimed at the other person that says nothing about the object.

lines.quote: So, no war with Iran, no nukes.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: States that there is no war and no nukes as things stand, the realized side.

lines.quote: until then, I'm right yet again
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: A claim about the speaker's own record that says nothing about the object's condition.

lines.quote: That didn't happen - that WONT happen
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says the feared outcome, US boots on the ground, has not come and will not, which leans realized by rule 5.

lines.quote: You're just missing the bigger picture here.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, answering critics of the June 2025 strikes
lines.why: The line frames the strikes as a win, since no US ground war followed, though it names little itself; read from the post's context it leans toward no sustained war.

lines.quote: we didn't want to be embroiled in a forever war in the Middle East - but it was in good faith!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, speaking for those who opposed a forever war
lines.why: It says the speakers wanted no forever war, and the post's context treats that outcome as avoided, which leans toward no war.

lines.quote: Many denouncing Trump and MAGA were doing so because they're personally invested in seeing the administration fail.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, on Trump and MAGA critics
lines.why: The line is about the motives of critics, not the state of the war.

lines.quote: Can I get a war with Iran update?
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, asking war-warning accounts for news
lit: Can I get a war with Iran update?
lines.why: A bare question that takes no side on the object's condition.

lines.quote: You guys had all those big spaces and posts about regime change, nuclear strikes and Americans dying for Israel.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, on what the critics had predicted
lines.why: It recalls past predictions of a worse war to imply they did not come true, so it leans toward no war.

lines.quote: No "war with Iran."
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, on the state of play after the strikes
lines.why: It says plainly that the feared war has not come, which per rule 5 takes the realized side.

lines.quote: Everyone said MAGA was "over" last week. Instead we got the biggest ever increase in ICE and border funding possible. Thank you TRUMP!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, on MAGA critics and the funding bill
lines.why: It is about who was right and credit to Trump, and the funding it names is not the war.

lines.quote: If there's a single US boot dropped on Iran during Trump's presidency, I'll make a video denouncing the entire MAGA movement.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7, on a US ground deployment in Iran
lit: single US boot dropped on Iran
lines.why: It is a conditional pledge about a course the speaker says is not under way, so it takes no side on where things stand.

lines.quote: Immigration is the greatest issue we face in the West.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: A claim about immigration's rank as an issue says nothing about the Iran war or any measured condition of the object.

lines.quote: All of these people listed are pro immigration. I don't care if they're "based anti zionists" - they're the enemy
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Labels named people as enemies over their loyalties, which is a line about who they are and not about the object.

lines.quote: Of course there are no "boots on the ground" in Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: there are no "boots on the ground" in Iran
lines.why: Says a bad state (ground troops) has not come, which rule 5 reads as leaning realized.

lines.quote: these liars know this, they just want to score internet points for headpats from cult leader figures
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Attributes motives to critics, so it is about their character and not the war.

lines.quote: I think boots on ground would be a big mistake and still do!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: boots on ground would be a big mistake
lines.why: Weighs a course the speaker says nobody is on, so under rule 3 it takes no side.

lines.quote: But we have to see how this plays out.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: we have to see how this plays out
lines.why: A wait-and-see line that says nothing about where the object stands.

lines.quote: Of course there are no boots on the ground in Iran
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: there are no boots on the ground in Iran
lines.why: States that no ground troops are in Iran, which rule 5 reads as leaning realized.

lines.quote: even if there were, I don't care anymore. As long as He controls immigration, I don't care what happens.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lines.why: Gives up caring about outcomes in exchange for immigration control and describes no condition of the war, so it takes no side.

lines.quote: I'm skeptical of these strikes
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, speaking for himself
lines.why: He doubts the strikes while the war is under way, which leans toward the war frustrating the no-war promise.

lines.quote: we should in no universe have boots on the ground in Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, speaking for himself
lit: in no universe have boots on the ground
lines.why: He weighs a ground invasion that nobody in the post is said to be pursuing, so by rule 3 it takes no side.

lines.quote: let's hope this resolves quickly
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, speaking for himself
lines.why: A hope says nothing about where the object stands, so it takes no side.

lines.quote: I'm willing to give Trump the benefit of the doubt.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, speaking for himself
lit: give Trump the benefit of the doubt
lines.why: This is about the speaker's own stance toward Trump, not a reading of the war, so it is shadow.

lines.quote: The price one pays for nuance on this app:
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, speaking for himself
lit: The price one pays for nuance
lines.why: He complains about how he is treated on the app, which is about himself and his critics, not the war.

lines.quote: All these people do is lie
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, speaking of his critics
lit: All these people do is lie
lines.why: It attacks the honesty of critics, which is blame and not a reading of the object.

lines.quote: now that it's happening I hope it is resolved quickly and we can move onto other things
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, speaking for himself
lit: I hope it is resolved quickly
lines.why: Although it grants the war is happening, the line is mainly a hope, so by rule 2 it takes no side.

lines.quote: Like I've always said, I think it would be a massive mistake for some boots on the ground invasion of Iran.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer, speaking for himself
lit: boots on the ground invasion of Iran
lines.why: He weighs an invasion that the line itself says nobody is on, so by rule 3 it takes no side.

lines.quote: Clearly that's not happening and there's very little chance it will happen.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: very little chance it will happen
lines.why: The line says a ground invasion of Iran has not come and is unlikely, which under rule 5 reads leaning realized on the war.

lines.quote: I explicitly opposed the Iran war from the outset
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: I explicitly opposed the Iran war
lines.why: The line is about the speaker's own past record on the war, not the war's condition, so it is shadow.

lines.quote: didn't call any reasonable critics "third worldists." This is very disappointing to see from you.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: This is very disappointing to see from you
lines.why: The line defends the speaker's own conduct and rebukes another person, which is a matter of record and loyalty, not the war itself.

lines.quote: The people attacking me daily were these
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: The people attacking me daily were these
lines.why: The line says who has been attacking the speaker, which is about blame and personal standing, not the state of the war.
